maddeler.e:
أتناسل (form VI)
# أَتَنَاسَلُ (ʔatanāsalu) /ʔa.ta.naː.sa.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَنَاسَلَ (tanāsala)
# أَتَنَاسَلَ (ʔatanāsala) /ʔa.ta.naː.sa.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَنَاسَلَ (tanāsala)
# أَتَنَاسَلْ (ʔatanāsal) /ʔa.ta.naː.sal/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَنَاسَلَ (tanāsala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
